references.text: The Levites were assigned to serve under Aaron the priest, which explains the hierarchy where Eleazar has oversight over the Levites.
Eleazar, son of Aaron, had charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the oil, the incense, and the daily grain offering.
Eleazar succeeded his father Aaron as high priest, confirming his leading position among the Levites.
Eleazar is mentioned as a son of Aaron, and his lineage is established here.
Aaron and his sons, including Eleazar, were chosen for priestly service.
Eleazar and Ithamar are named as the surviving sons of Aaron after the death of Nadab and Abihu.
Moses, Aaron, and his sons kept watch in front of the tabernacle and guarded the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites.
Phinehas, son of Eleazar, was leader over the guards at the house of the Lord, showing the continuation of Eleazar's oversight role.
